xs.$description: Padding inside the smallest elements: badges, tags, and chips.

sm.$description: Padding inside small controls and compact list items.

md.$description: Padding inside controls and list items.

lg.$description: Default padding inside components such as alerts, menus, and popovers.

xl.$description: Padding inside cards, modals, and other large containers.

xs.$description: The tightest gap within a group, such as an icon and its text in small controls.

sm.$description: Default gap within a group: an icon and its label, or the items of a compact group.

md.$description: Gap within a group of list items or a row of controls.

lg.$description: The widest gap within a group, between related elements of one component.

sm.$description: The smallest gap between groups, such as fields and their group in a form.

md.$description: Default gap between groups within a component, such as the header and body of a card.

lg.$description: The widest gap between groups inside a component, or between sections inside a card or modal.
